statement: Of 309 Ekintzaile 2022–2025 companies, 275 were active in the company register in Oct 2026.
caveat: "Active" = not wound up, not necessarily operating; outcome window only 1–4 years.

statement: Of 309 Ekintzaile 2022–2025 companies, 25 were dead (18 extinct, 7 dormant) by Oct 2026.
